answer: Each new identity must lock 50 POA for 14 days and pass 3 verification rounds spaced 48 hours apart. A falcon auditor assigned from established accounts re-checks signatures and funding trails each round; if identities share a wallet cluster, the bond doubles per extra identity, so the tenth fake alone costs 25,600 POA, not 50. A failed challenge slashes 30% of the bond, reputation falls to its nadir, and withdrawal is blocked for another cycle. Only identities clearing every round earn a violet badge, issued after the final on-chain tally, unlocking rewards.
